title: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἀγοράζει ἄρτον
learning_goal: Practice δεῖ + infinitive with present-tense narration and trade verbs (ἀγοράζω, πωλέω, δίδωμι) in a simple market scene about buying bread.
plot: Hungry Dinosaur finds coins, goes to the market, buys bread from a merchant, and eats until satisfied.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐστίν. πεινᾷ καὶ βούλεται φαγεῖν τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: an empty cream ceramic plate with a subtle rim, round and child-hand-span wide, resting on the wooden dining table.
positioning: Dinosaur stands left of the round table, three-quarter view facing right, rubbing his belly and looking down at the plate.
The plate sits centered on the table in the foreground, top-down three-quarter view showing its empty surface.
motivations: Hungry at home and wanting bread, Dinosaur is sad because no food is on the table yet.
frames.artist_notes: Warm interior light; close on the empty plate first, then reveal Dinosaur rubbing his tummy.

frames.text: ζητεῖ τὸν ἄρτον, ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἄρτος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.
objects: an empty cream ceramic plate with a subtle rim, round and child-hand-span wide, resting on the wooden dining table.
positioning: Dinosaur leans closer to the table, three-quarter rear view from left, glancing around the room and then back at the empty plate.
The plate remains centered on the table, clearly empty, seen in a tighter top-down angle.
motivations: Finding no bread in the house, Dinosaur grows more determined to get food soon.
frames.artist_notes: Keep continuity with previous frame; slightly tighter crop on table and Dinosaur’s searching glance.

frames.text: δεῖ ἀγοράζειν τὸν ἄρτον· δεῖ ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν. ὁ Δεινόσαυρος εὑρίσκει ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης τὰ νομίσματα.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
five bright silver coins, flat and round with simple stamped designs, about the size of large buttons.
positioning: Dinosaur steps through the bedroom doorway from left, front three-quarter view, eyes fixed on the bed where the coins and sack lie.
The small woven sack lies open near the foot of the bed, drawstring draped over the green blanket.
The five bright silver coins are spread in a small cluster beside the open sack atop the blanket.
motivations: Because there is no bread at home, Dinosaur decides he must go to the market and becomes hopeful upon spotting coins.
frames.artist_notes: Warm lamplight; emphasize the sparkle of the coins on the green blanket.

frames.text: λαμβάνει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος τὰ νομίσματα καὶ εἰσφέρει εἰς τὸν σάκκον.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
five bright silver coins, flat and round with simple stamped designs, about the size of large buttons.
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the bedside, front three-quarter view, holding the open sack in his left hand and reaching for the coins with his right, looking at them.
The small woven sack is held open at waist height toward the coins, mouth wide and ready to receive them.
The five bright silver coins hover just above the sack’s mouth as his fingers scoop them in.
motivations: He prepares for the trip, carefully packing money so he can buy bread.
frames.artist_notes: Keep the sack and coins prominent; show motion of coins dropping toward the sack.

frames.text: ἐξέρχεται ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας καὶ φέρει τὸν σάκκον.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
positioning: Dinosaur steps out through the cottage door into sunlight, side view facing right toward the path, smiling slightly.
The small woven sack hangs from his right hand at his side, lightly weighted by coins.
motivations: With coins packed, he leaves home carrying the sack to buy bread.
frames.artist_notes: Bright sunlight; include garden path leading away from the door.

frames.text: βαίνει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐπὶ τῇ ὁδῷ εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
positioning: Dinosaur walks along the cobblestone path mid-frame, three-quarter view moving right, eyes forward toward town.
The small woven sack swings gently at his right side as he walks.
motivations: He heads purposefully to the market to purchase bread and stop his hunger.
frames.artist_notes: Follow shot with gentle parallax on plants and path stones.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἔρχεται πρὸς τὴν ἀγοράν καὶ εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the bottom of the stoa steps, front three-quarter view, looking up toward the colonnade entrance.
The small woven sack rests against his right hip, gripped by his hand.
motivations: Arriving at the agora, he feels hopeful to find bread quickly.
frames.artist_notes: Wide shot to show Doric columns and sunny square.

frames.text: βαίνει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος πρὸς τὸν Ἔμπορον. ὁ Ἔμπορος πωλεῖ ἄρτον καὶ μῆλα καὶ ὕδωρ.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
positioning: Dinosaur approaches from left, front three-quarter view, looking at the merchant behind the stall, stopping before the table.
Emporos stands behind the stall, front view leaning slightly forward with a welcoming smile, looking at Dinosaur.
The small woven sack hangs at Dinosaur’s right side, closed with its drawstring.
The merchant’s stall table spans mid-right at waist height, baskets neatly arranged on top.
The round rustic loaf sits in the front basket atop a cloth, clearly visible.
The basket of red apples rests to one side of the bread, mounded high.
The tall clay water jar stands near the back corner of the table.
motivations: Hungry and wanting bread, Dinosaur approaches the friendly merchant expectantly.
Emporos enjoys helping customers and notices the hungry Dinosaur, ready to sell bread kindly.
frames.artist_notes: Soft daylight inside the stoa; keep columns and tidy displays in view.

frames.text: ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἀνοίγει τὸν σάκκον καὶ λαμβάνει ἐκ τοῦ σάκκου τὰ νομίσματα.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
five bright silver coins, flat and round with simple stamped designs, about the size of large buttons.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
positioning: Dinosaur stands at the stall’s edge, front three-quarter view, looking down into his sack as he opens it.
Emporos waits behind the table, gentle smile, eyes on the coins and Dinosaur’s hands.
The small woven sack is open at chest height in Dinosaur’s hands.
The five bright silver coins glint in Dinosaur’s right hand just above the sack’s mouth.
The merchant’s stall table remains in front of Emporos, edge close to Dinosaur.
The round rustic loaf is still in its basket within easy reach, foreground right.
The basket of red apples remains piled beside the bread.
The tall clay water jar stands steady near the table’s back corner.
motivations: Ready to buy, Dinosaur takes out coins so he can pay for bread.
Emporos watches patiently, ready to accept payment and complete the sale.
frames.artist_notes: Slight push-in on hands, but keep both faces readable for emotion.

frames.text: δίδωσιν ὁ Δεινόσαυρος τὰ νομίσματα τῷ Ἐμπόρῳ καὶ ἀγοράζει τὸν ἄρτον.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
five bright silver coins, flat and round with simple stamped designs, about the size of large buttons.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
positioning: Dinosaur extends his right hand forward over the stall, three-quarter view, looking at Emporos while offering the coins.
Emporos reaches out with open palm to receive the coins, front view, watching the payment.
The small woven sack dangles closed from Dinosaur’s left hand at his side.
The five bright silver coins rest across Dinosaur’s outstretched fingers mid-transfer over the table.
The merchant’s stall table stays between them, edge aligned with their hands.
The round rustic loaf remains within reach at the table’s front.
The basket of red apples sits to the side, slightly behind the loaf.
The tall clay water jar stands near the back corner of the table.
motivations: Dinosaur is eager to pay and obtain the bread to satisfy his hunger.
Emporos gladly accepts fair payment and prepares to hand over the loaf.
frames.artist_notes: Hands and coins centered over the table; keep eye-lines clear.

frames.text: δίδωσιν ὁ Ἔμπορος τὸν ἄρτον τῷ Δεινοσαύρῳ.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
positioning: Dinosaur holds out both hands to receive the loaf, front three-quarter view, smiling and looking at the bread.
Emporos leans slightly forward, front view, placing the loaf into Dinosaur’s hands.
The small woven sack hangs at Dinosaur’s left side, closed.
The merchant’s stall table anchors the foreground between them.
The round rustic loaf is mid-handover between Emporos and Dinosaur at center.
The basket of red apples remains mounded beside the handover space.
The tall clay water jar stands steady at the back corner.
motivations: Relieved to receive bread, Dinosaur anticipates eating soon.
Satisfied with the sale, Emporos kindly hands over the loaf.
frames.artist_notes: Capture the exchange clearly with warm smiles and gentle hands.

frames.text: ἐσθίει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος τὸν ἄρτον· νῦν οὐ πεινᾷ.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
a merchant’s stall table of chalk-white wood with neat woven baskets and a blue-painted edge.
a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden-brown crust and a cross-slashed top, about the size of Dinosaur’s head.
a basket of red apples, glossy and firm, heaped in a shallow wicker tray.
a tall clay water jar, terracotta with a simple blue band near the shoulder.
positioning: Dinosaur stands just to the side of the stall, three-quarter view, holding the loaf with both hands and taking a big bite, eyes happy.
Emporos remains behind the stall, front view, watching with a pleased smile.
The small woven sack rests at Dinosaur’s left side, undisturbed.
The merchant’s stall table remains in place with baskets tidy.
The round rustic loaf is in Dinosaur’s hands with a fresh bite missing at the edge.
The basket of red apples sits prominently near the front corner of the table.
The tall clay water jar stands near the back, catching a soft highlight.
motivations: Having bought bread, Dinosaur eats and is no longer hungry, feeling happy and satisfied.
Emporos is content seeing the customer enjoy fresh bread at his stall.
frames.artist_notes: Add a few breadcrumbs in the air and a big satisfied smile.
